decision.reasoning_trace: After filtering out the non-speaker accessories (cases, power cords, and wall shelves), I selected five actual speakers that spanned different price points and use cases. I considered the premium Bang & Olufsen (prod_195) for top-tier audio, the JBL Clip 3 (prod_002) for rugged portability, and the EWA (prod_192) for its ultra-compact form factor. I also looked at the high-wattage BOGASING (prod_174). Ultimately, I chose the Philips BT6000B (prod_084) because it offers a 360-degree sound experience and splash-proofing at a very competitive price. The reviews specifically highlighted its exceptional sound quality ('an orgasm for the ears'), making it the best balance of price and immersive performance in the set.
